subject.title: iOS chat polish: haptic feedback and Markdown transcript export

question: Should OpenClaw accept both iOS chat polish additions, narrow the scope to one, or defer the feature direction after reviewing the two linked PRs?
rationale: The issue requests new user-facing iOS behavior, carries a protected maintainer label, and the actual implementation work is split across two unmerged PRs.

options.title: Review linked PRs separately
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the haptics PR and transcript-export PR as the concrete implementation paths.

options.title: Narrow the umbrella
options.body: Choose only haptics or only transcript export for now and ask the other PR to be closed or deferred.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave both features out of core iOS for now and close or pause the linked PRs with a product rationale.

recommendation.title: Review linked PRs separately
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the haptics PR and transcript-export PR as the concrete implementation paths.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete is the live issue opener, linked PR author, and current-history owner for the relevant iOS/shared chat files.
